name: Mandala Medley
description:
Ever wondered how simple dots, lines, and shapes turn into intricate mandalas?

In this workshop, we'll explore the basics of mandala art and see how simple shapes, when repeated and put together, can turn into beautiful patterns. You'll learn a few techniques, play around with dots, petals, curves and geometric shapes, and create a mandala of your own along the way.

Never drawn anything beyond a stick figure? That's absolutely fine! You don't need any prior experience, just a little curiosity and a willingness to give it a go.

name: DEVI a concert by Bhargavi Venkatram
description:
Carnatic music like you've never felt it before.

Sacred Echoes is a concert series where each night is built around one devotional theme. The music flows as one continuous journey. This edition is a celebration of Devi in all her forms, and the divine feminine reflected in the women who shape our lives.

Bhargavi Venkatram and her ensemble blend traditional Carnatic music with electronica and modern sound design. The classical core stays true, but the sound is bigger, deeper and more immersive. LED visuals, stage lighting and concert-grade sound bring each piece to life.

And you're part of it too. The whole hall sings together, and as the energy builds, the night turns into a bhajan clubbing experience.

Whether you grew up on Carnatic music or you're hearing it live for the first time, this one's for you.

Doors open at 6.30PM

Nov 20 | 7PM

📍Auditorium, PCPA, Bengaluru

name: Make your own Sashiko Bookmarks
description:
Japanese crafts are designed to be mindful, calming and skill-building, matching perfectly with our ethos at Knot Therapy.

Sashiko is an embroidery technique developed to preserve both garments and resources. Its unique style of using the minimum material by creating geometric patterns while reinforcing the fabric in such a way that it not only survives heavy use but the mending is decorative - the flaw becomes part of its beauty.

Join us to explore a brand new thread craft, some interesting history, make your very own bookmarks, all while learning a new technique to regulate yourself and make some calm with your own hands.

**What you get:**

4 sets of bookmarks to experiment with

Safe supplies to create the punch base

All tools & threads to create the embroidery

A guided and quiet experience, curated by your own pace & aesthetic.

**Open to Ages 16+**

name: Lino Printing Workshop with Aparna Konat!
description:
This hands-on workshop introduces the basics of lino cut printmaking, from carving a simple design to inking and printing your own artwork. Participants will be guided through the process step by step and will leave with their own prints, perfect as small artworks or gifts.

The session runs for **three hours** and includes demonstrations, supported making time, and space to experiment.

Open to beginners and anyone curious about printmaking — no prior experience needed. Suitable for ages 14+.

**What should I bring?**

Clothes you don’t mind getting messy in, ideas or finished sketches for designs (found images from books are welcome), and lots of creativity.

**What’s provided?**

All printing tools, paper, and inks will be provided.

**What do I take home?**

All finished artworks are yours to keep, along with any unfinished pieces. Participants will also keep their carved lino block, allowing them to reprint at home with basic supplies.

**What's included**

- Lino sheet
- Lino carving tool
- Lino ink
- 140gsm paper
- Baren
- Roller

name: Side A/Side B: Californication with Sachin Bhatt
description:
A listening session of **Californication, t**he album that gave the Chili Peppers a second life.

The **Red Hot Chili Peppers**' seventh record came out of the band's lowest years and turned into their biggest success. Frusciante came back to the band. The rap-rock novelty label fell away, and what replaced it was Kiedis writing his most reflective lyrics, Flea holding everything up from underneath, and some of the most thoughtful guitar playing at the turn of the century.

The session is hosted by **Sachin Bhatt,** a Bangalore artist who has spent years making visuals for some of music's most loved artists. He's an art director and a vinyl collector, and he makes music in his spare time. On Sunday he brings this record and the story behind his pick.

Verse and Worse Karaoke with Aashish Paul - Dramatic duets, forgotten lyrics, guilty pleasure anthems - all welcome here. Hosted by Aashish Paul at The Humming Tree. No judgment, just good music and louder singalongs 😎

The Humming Tree - A grassroots performance venue in Bangalore, running from 2013 to 2019 and in the process becoming a cornerstone of Bangalore’s independent music, art, and cultural ecosystem.

Now, in 2026, The Humming Tree is back in a brand-new, purpose-designed space in Indiranagar. Built across 12,000 sq. ft., the venue features a 600+ capacity performance space, world-class sound and lighting systems, and a diverse F&B proposition. More than just a venue, it’s a hub for creativity, culture and collaboration.

name: An Hour of Stillness - An immersive sound experience
description:
Somewhere between the demands of the day and the things waiting for tomorrow, there is a little space to pause.

Join Sri for an immersive 60-minute sound experience with Himalayan singing bowls, crystal bowls, handpan, ocean drum and gong.

Through layers of sound, moments of quiet and a gentle return to the present, you'll have an hour to simply listen.

There's nothing to learn, no experience required and nothing you need to achieve.

Just come as you are. Get comfortable. Listen.

**What to expect**

- A gentle arrival and grounding
- An immersive journey through live instrumental sounds
- Moments of quiet and stillness
- Time to return slowly before the session closes

**Who is this for?**

Anyone looking to step away from the demands of everyday life and make a little room for themselves. No prior meditation or sound experience is needed.
